scope: Independent Decimal reconstruction of frozen 2027-2028 EPS, economic cash, presentation controls, slower Foundry cost case and the finite reverse cash hurdle. No new research, operating forecast or equity value selection.
method: Read source JSON independently; rebuilt consolidated EBIT from current host segment profits plus corporate and incremental packaging; rebuilt D&A, capex and working capital from host plus packaging; derived credits and tax from frozen policy; rebuilt EPS and inverse algebra without calling root calculator; recomputed liquidity sequentially from opening cash.

double_count_findings.result: No new double count found within the declared total-D&A convention. The 0.25B is excluded from adjusted EPS, then removed by inverse reconstruction before full normalized D&A is added once. Source corporate policy explicitly puts it inside total D&A. A full future book amortization roll-forward is not proven.

Identified 2.6B/2.8B corporate SBC is added back only for EPS and illustrative issuer cash presentation; economic cash continues to expense it once. Planning shares represent existing claims, and the controls do not alter cash or create a second future dilution charge. Packaging SBC remains unsplit and expensed.

Adjusted EPS deducts 1.1B guidance proxy plus 0.15B share of excluded adjustments. Inverse algebra restores both before economic cash deducts the 1.1B reserve once. Issuer-style proxy reverses that reserve, then separately assumes zero distributions or distributions equal to the reserve. No partner contributions are fabricated.

Current 1B is excluded from physical capex and charged once in treasury. EPS subtracts 0/0.125B of chosen new book depreciation, which inverse reconstruction removes before original cash is calculated. The 2028 0.01875B tax shield follows the separate tax-depreciation cohort, not an immediate deduction of current 1B.

11% adjusted presentation tax is fully undone. Cash uses 15% operating tax, taxes interest income, then adds ordinary-interest and prior capitalized-interest tax shields once. New credits are collected at a one-year lag; the origin-year basis-loss tax is subtracted once. Illustrative book benefit raises EPS only and reverses out of cash.

Original all-in 1B supplier/lease cash allowance stays once; ordinary 1.6B debt interest excludes that envelope under the source policy. Presentation lease stress is reversed before cash, preventing an added 1B cash charge. Exact future finance-lease interest, principal and D&A mapping remain unknown.

Reconstruction uses the CURRENT host Foundry path of -4/-0.75B plus the incremental packaging overlay. It does not reuse the packaging file old host-combined profit or add gross packaging profit on top of the net overlap adjustment.

remaining_comparability_limits.finding: The 2028 public EPS forecast does not disclose its full tax, adjustments and weighted-share methodology; the 2027 summary is adjusted EPS but constituent accounting choices are not reconstructed. The measured percentage premiums are arithmetic comparisons between proxies, not certified like-for-like analyst forecast errors.
remaining_comparability_limits.proof_needed: Original analyst income statements and definitions, normalized on the same timing, NCI, compensation and diluted-share basis.

remaining_comparability_limits.finding: 5.51B is existing planning claims, not independently forecast future weighted diluted shares. Future equity grants, vesting, cancellations, stock price and treasury-stock proceeds are not modeled.
remaining_comparability_limits.proof_needed: Dated weighted-share roll-forward and grant/vesting assumptions for each forecast year.

remaining_comparability_limits.finding: The reference EPS omits a separately unallocated lease-interest expense; 1B is an all-in cash envelope, and assumed lease D&A inside total D&A is not independently itemized. The severe 1B control is not a book accounting forecast.
remaining_comparability_limits.proof_needed: Supplier/lease asset, liability, interest, cash and D&A schedules reconciled to EBIT and ordinary interest.

remaining_comparability_limits.finding: Only identified corporate SBC is restored in the issuer-style cash proxy. Packaging central cost includes unsplit SBC, so exact issuer CFO would require its noncash portion and any tax-settlement effects. No numerical correction is justified without that split.
remaining_comparability_limits.proof_needed: Packaging compensation split and cash-flow reconciliation; do not add the full central cost as SBC.

remaining_comparability_limits.finding: Forward book credit depreciation benefit, capitalized-interest book life, financing PPE settlement timing and capital-tax classification are simplified or unallocated. Exact issuer adjusted FCF cannot be claimed from an economic reserve model.
remaining_comparability_limits.proof_needed: PPE/credit/interest cohort schedules, cash-purchase settlement mapping, actual partner funding/distributions and a complete CFO-to-adjusted-FCF bridge.

remaining_comparability_limits.finding: Slower Foundry is a cost-only control at unchanged product revenue, margins, capex and working capital. It is not a failed qualification, delayed shipment or joint macro downside. The 31.218B 2028 ending balance is economic liquidity after reserves, not measured bank cash.
remaining_comparability_limits.proof_needed: A separately frozen operating scenario to claim robustness to revenue or shipment failure; none is inferred here.

reverse_cash_hurdle_audit.timing_explanation: End-2029 first cash is capitalized one period earlier at end-2028, then discounted two years to end-2026. Positive price gap requires positive extra cash. Formula is correct for a 3%-growing perpetual unlevered cash increment discounted at 12%, fixed claims and all other inputs held constant.
reverse_cash_hurdle_audit.limits: This holds financing, reinvestment and claims fixed and compares a November 3 price with an end-2026 planning value. It does not identify the market expectation or demonstrate feasible savings.
